0022600189.text: Indiana, the designated home team, comes into this neutral-site NBA Mexico City Game at 2-6, with a 0-4 home record, a 2-2 road record, and a five-game losing streak, placing 12th in the East and third in the Central, 4.5 games back. Denver is 3-3 and on a one-game losing streak, sitting 10th in the West and fourth in the Northwest, 2 games back, and the teams have not played yet in 2026-27 after Indiana lost both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 135-120 in Indianapolis on December 3, 2025. Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery), Kelly Oubre Jr. (calf bruise), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), while Denver is without DeMar DeRozan (back spasms), Julian Strawther (knee sprain), and Spencer Jones (hamstring).
